cover.title: The 140-Day Recoil
cover.subtitle: Reverse Listening + Deep Recall over the entire life of arcs-v9 — 1,535 commits, Day-1 scaffold (2026-04-09) to the Ahmed close (2026-08-27)
cover.meta: Window 2026-04-09 → 2026-08-27 · 1,535 commits · 66 ADRs · 251 tao proverbs · handoffs v0.1.0 → v3.44.0

loadBearingQuote.text: One inbound … run end-to-end through the full stage-print arc, throwing off a class, an invariant, and repo-wide gate hardening.
loadBearingQuote.attribution: Handoff v3.42.0 — the sentence the whole arc was converging toward

callWalk.label: APR 9 — MAY 17
callWalk.title: The scaffold and the silence
callWalk.body: One commit: 'Day 1 scaffold — Next.js 16 + Prisma 7 + Auth.js v5 magic link.' Then five weeks of nothing in this repo. Read forward it looks like a stall; read backward it was gestation — when work resumed, the DEWY pipeline landed whole.

callWalk.label: MAY 18–31
callWalk.title: The product era
callWalk.body: 86 commits: compass, brief, guide, history, prep, Y-gate, tributaries; Auth.js magic link; the tokens.ts design system; RLS deny-all; canon Book II Parts V–VI promoted CANONICAL; ADRs 003–013. The repo believed it was a self-serve SaaS decision product.

callWalk.label: JUNE
callWalk.title: The polish spiral
callWalk.body: 370 commits, mostly consumer-surface polish — eyebrow, breadbox, footer, form stacking, toast limits — with visible duplicated commits and NCI scores climbing past 120. Highest-effort, lowest-leverage stretch of the window: the front door got beautiful while nobody was walking through it.

callWalk.label: JULY
callWalk.title: The counterpart pivot
callWalk.body: 671 commits — the volume peak. Todd/PRL chatbot (SEM onramp, Tidio flows, SugarCRM), the omakase family (jeben → louisville), and the recoil-report machinery itself (the first eleven generated reports date from here). Mid-month, the 2026-07-19 token-efficiency audit rewrote CLAUDE.md governance. The repo stopped being an app and became an engagement engine.

callWalk.label: AUG 1–11
callWalk.title: The family goes public, drift becomes receipts
callWalk.body: playground.arcs.care + monolith live; tripwire + deploy-verify (ADR-050/051/052); /witness and /night-moves born; the Yuri suite gauntleted four deep and SENT. The honesty machinery caught its first real receipt (jargon in the forge pages).

callWalk.label: AUG 12–23
callWalk.title: The engagement gauntlet
callWalk.body: PRL 1.1/1.2 chatbot→Sugar verified end-to-end and shipped to Todd. The Scott surface family (onedoor, two teardowns, attraction-field, ADR-067). Then Wing: 14 PRs, wing.arcs.care, PRESENT mode, and the teardown-page-factory skill — the instance that threw off its own class.

callWalk.label: AUG 24–27
callWalk.title: The doctrine consolidation and the close
callWalk.body: ADR-068 verb×altitude gate matrix wired into 7 skills; Tao v1.1.0; the seed bank and witness spine; the NFTT data-driven story engine; the Jeben dogfood epoch. And the close: the long-parked Ahmed 60-Second Read shipped, gauntlet-hardened, ex-ante receipted — the window ends on a drafted note awaiting a human hand.

signalThreads.label: THREAD 01
signalThreads.title: Every instance throws off a factory
signalThreads.body: Wing → teardown-page-factory. Blog posts → NFTT story engine. Jeben → omakase-pipeline. Wrap bug → a banked failure-mode class. Gauntlet → ADR-068 gates. The dominant kinematic of the whole window: instances get generalized into classes with falling marginal cost (Wing's efficiency contract prices the next run at ~1/3).
signalThreads.note: This is the strongest argument the repo makes for itself.

signalThreads.label: THREAD 02
signalThreads.title: The commit curve tells the pivot story
signalThreads.body: 1 → 86 → 370 → 671 → 407 commits by month. The June bulge is consumer polish; the July peak is counterpart delivery; August's decline is not slowdown but compression — the 2026-07-19 token-efficiency regime plus factory-class reuse means fewer, denser commits per shipped surface.

signalThreads.label: THREAD 03
signalThreads.title: Honesty machinery compounded faster than product
signalThreads.body: NCI trailers → tripwire CI → drift receipts → /witness live attestation → ex-ante receipts filed before sends → ADR-068's mandatory blocking gates. 66 ADRs and 251 proverbs deep, the gates now do real work: a confabulated timestamp got corrected in-session, a gauntlet verify stage rejected a false fix, a never-replied send is on the record as never-replied.

signalThreads.label: THREAD 04
signalThreads.title: The original product is frozen in May
signalThreads.body: Compass, dashboard, brief — the DEWY SaaS core — has barely moved since June. The P1 backlog named in AGENTS.md (outcome handler, receipt save prompt — 'biggest PLG gap') is unchanged across the entire window. Revenue-shaped attention went to PRL/Todd and bespoke counterpart surfaces instead.
signalThreads.note: Deliberate pivot or unacknowledged drift — the corpus never says which out loud.

best.title: The factories compound
best.body: Next 140 days: teardown/omakase/PRL factories each run 3–5 more counterparts at 1/3 cost; close-loops start converting (Sean, Ahmed, PRL 1.2 re-pricing); one factory class gets productized back into the frozen compass core, reopening the self-serve path with earned evidence.
best.note: Requires the close-loop verb to get exercised as hard as the print verb.

base.title: Engagement engine, artisan throughput
base.body: The pattern of the last 60 days continues: inbound-driven counterpart surfaces at S-tier polish, doctrine deepening, one-to-two paying relationships. Sustainable, impressive, and gated on a single human for every send, sign-off, and billing fix.

worst.title: Doctrine outruns the ledger
worst.body: ADRs, seeds, and proverbs keep compounding while close-loops keep slipping (the prospecting/PRL computation has now missed three consecutive sessions). The system becomes exquisite at describing its own physics and stops metabolizing outcomes — entropy masquerading as motion, the exact enemy WORLD.md names.

riskFlags.label: Close-loop debt
riskFlags.body: Three loops open at window close: Sean Wing (silence trigger 2026-08-30), Ahmed (note drafted, unsent), PRL 1.2 close-loop (overdue, 3 sessions slipped). ADR-068 made close-loop a mandatory gate; its first real test is this week.

riskFlags.label: Single-threaded human gate
riskFlags.body: Every send, the GitHub Actions billing fix, lattice regeneration, and orphan-seed curation all queue on Zach. Correct per NOTOMATION — but the queue is growing, and window-terminal artifacts increasingly end at 'awaiting hand-send.'

riskFlags.label: Frozen P1 backlog
riskFlags.body: Outcome handler and receipt-save prompt (named 'biggest PLG gap' in AGENTS.md) have been P1 and untouched for the full 140 days. Either demote them honestly or schedule them — a P1 that survives five months unmoved is a mislabeled P3.

riskFlags.label: Standing acceptable-reds
riskFlags.body: forge-pattern/forge-cut tripwire failures parked since early August; 6 CI workflows disabled on billing since 2026-08-23. Known, logged, and honest — but every week they stand, the gates' authority erodes a little.

riskFlags.label: The honesty gates are load-bearing
riskFlags.body: Across 140 days the record shows corrections filed against itself: confabulated timestamps fixed, false fixes rejected by verify stages, unanswered sends logged as unanswered. The corpus can be recoiled at all because it did not lie to itself.

protocol.label: STEP 1
protocol.title: Exercise the close verb this week
protocol.body: Gauntlet the parked Sean note before the 2026-08-30 trigger; batch the two Zach-gated unlocks (Ahmed send + Actions billing) into one sitting; run the overdue prospecting/PRL computation — one computation, two customers.

protocol.label: STEP 2
protocol.title: Rule on the frozen core
protocol.body: Make the compass/PLG freeze an explicit decision: either an ADR that demotes the self-serve product to dormant, or a scheduled slot that ships the receipt-save prompt. The 140-day record deserves a verdict, not an ellipsis.

protocol.label: STEP 3
protocol.title: Point one factory inward
protocol.body: The seed already exists ([[seed-recap-rewind-surface]]): run the teardown factory on the user's own receipt history. It is the cheapest test of whether the engagement engine can feed the product instead of replacing it.

protocol.label: STEP 4
protocol.title: Retire the acceptable-reds
protocol.body: Fix or formally gate forge-pattern/forge-cut, and re-enable the 6 workflows the moment billing clears. Zero standing reds is the only stable number.
